context: The institutional makeup of a national standards body  is  closely  related  to  the  income  level  of the  country  it  serves.  As  countries'  income  level increases, the number of national standards bodies that are private increases. Whereas all national standards  bodies  in  low-income  countries  have public  ownership,  only  56  percent  of  national standards  bodies  in  high-income  countries  are public (refer to table S3.1).
